share.signature: self, actor_id: str, file_id: str, recipient_id: str
share.snippet:
def share(self, actor_id: str, file_id: str, recipient_id: str):
        with self.lock:
            row = self.store.file(file_id)
            if row is None:
                raise BusinessError(404, "文件不存在")
            allowed = self.decide("share", {"actor_id": actor_id, "owner_id": row["owner_id"]}, row)
            self.bo_emit("share-policy", "decision", {"actor_id": actor_id, "file_id": file_id, "owner_id": row["owner_id"], "recipient_id": recipient_id}, {"allowed": allowed})
            if not allowed:
                raise BusinessError(403, "只有文件所有者可以共享")
            if recipient_id == actor_id or not self.store.user(recipient_id):
                raise BusinessError(400, "请选择另一位已有用户")
            before = next(item for item in self.store.snapshot()["files"] if item["id"] == file_id)
            transition = self.workflow.share(row, actor_id, recipient_id, before["grant_count"])
            self.store.share_file(file_id, recipient_id, transition["state"])
            current = self.store.file(file_id)
            self.bo_emit("share", "commit", {"actor_id": actor_id, "file_id": file_id, "recipient_id": recipient_id}, {"state": current["state"], "revision": current["revision"], "active": True, "before_state": row["state"], "event": transition["event"], "guards": transition["guards"]}, current, {**transition, "source": row["state"]})
            return {"file_id": file_id, "recipient_id": recipient_id, "active": True}

view.snippet:
def details(self, actor_id: str, file_id: str):
        row, values = self.read_access(actor_id, file_id)
        allowed = self.decide("view", values, row)
        self.bo_emit("view-policy", "decision", values, {"allowed": allowed})
        if not allowed:
            raise BusinessError(403, "你没有查看这个文件的权限")
        result = self.public_file(row)
        self.bo_emit("view", "return", {"actor_id": actor_id, "file_id": file_id}, {"name": row["name"], "size": row["size"], "owner_id": row["owner_id"]})
        return result

download.snippet:
def download(self, actor_id: str, file_id: str):
        row, values = self.read_access(actor_id, file_id)
        allowed = self.decide("download", values, row)
        self.bo_emit("download-policy", "decision", values, {"allowed": allowed})
        if not allowed:
            self.bo_emit("denied", "return", {"actor_id": actor_id, "file_id": file_id}, {"allowed": False})
            raise BusinessError(403, "你没有下载这个文件的权限")
        content = (self.blobs / row["storage_key"]).read_bytes()
        self.bo_emit("download", "return", {"actor_id": actor_id, "file_id": file_id}, {"size": len(content), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()})
        return row["name"], content

revoke.snippet:
def revoke(self, actor_id: str, file_id: str, recipient_id: str):
        with self.lock:
            row = self.store.file(file_id)
            if row is None:
                raise BusinessError(404, "文件不存在")
            allowed = self.decide("revoke", {"actor_id": actor_id, "owner_id": row["owner_id"]}, row)
            self.bo_emit("revoke-policy", "decision", {"actor_id": actor_id, "file_id": file_id, "owner_id": row["owner_id"], "recipient_id": recipient_id}, {"allowed": allowed})
            if not allowed:
                raise BusinessError(403, "只有文件所有者可以取消共享")
            if not self.store.user(recipient_id):
                raise BusinessError(400, "请选择已有接收者")
            grant = self.store.grant(file_id, recipient_id)
            before = next(item for item in self.store.snapshot()["files"] if item["id"] == file_id)
            remaining = before["grant_count"] - (1 if grant and grant["active"] else 0)
            transition = self.workflow.revoke(row, actor_id, recipient_id, remaining)
            self.store.revoke_file(file_id, recipient_id, transition["state"])
            current = self.store.file(file_id)
            self.bo_emit("revoke", "commit", {"actor_id": actor_id, "file_id": file_id, "recipient_id": recipient_id}, {"state": current["state"], "revision": current["revision"], "active": False, "before_state": row["state"], "event": transition["event"], "guards": transition["guards"]}, current, {**transition, "source": row["state"]})

revoke-policy.signature: self, actor_id: str, file_id: str, recipient_id: str
revoke-policy.snippet:
def revoke(self, actor_id: str, file_id: str, recipient_id: str):
        with self.lock:
            row = self.store.file(file_id)
            if row is None:
                raise BusinessError(404, "文件不存在")
            allowed = self.decide("revoke", {"actor_id": actor_id, "owner_id": row["owner_id"]}, row)
            self.bo_emit("revoke-policy", "decision", {"actor_id": actor_id, "file_id": file_id, "owner_id": row["owner_id"], "recipient_id": recipient_id}, {"allowed": allowed})
            if not allowed:
                raise BusinessError(403, "只有文件所有者可以取消共享")
            if not self.store.user(recipient_id):
                raise BusinessError(400, "请选择已有接收者")
            grant = self.store.grant(file_id, recipient_id)
            before = next(item for item in self.store.snapshot()["files"] if item["id"] == file_id)
            remaining = before["grant_count"] - (1 if grant and grant["active"] else 0)
            transition = self.workflow.revoke(row, actor_id, recipient_id, remaining)
            self.store.revoke_file(file_id, recipient_id, transition["state"])
            current = self.store.file(file_id)
            self.bo_emit("revoke", "commit", {"actor_id": actor_id, "file_id": file_id, "recipient_id": recipient_id}, {"state": current["state"], "revision": current["revision"], "active": False, "before_state": row["state"], "event": transition["event"], "guards": transition["guards"]}, current, {**transition, "source": row["state"]})
            return {"file_id": file_id, "recipient_id": recipient_id, "active": False}

def reply(self, status, data, headers=None):
        raw = data if isinstance(data, bytes) else json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False).encode()
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/octet-stream" if isinstance(data, bytes) else "application/json; charset=utf-8")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(raw)))
        self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
        self.send_header("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
        for key, value in (headers or {}).items():
            self.send_header(key, value)
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(raw)
        self.server.service.bo_emit("http", "return", {"method": self.command, "path": urlsplit(self.path).path}, {"status": status})
